description: Updates an existing campaign in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated.

actual_cost.description: Updated actual cost. Leave unset to keep unchanged.
actual_cost.human_parameter_description: How much has actually been spent on this campaign so far. Enter a number, or leave blank to keep the current amount.
actual_cost.title: Actual Cost

budgeted_cost.description: Updated budgeted cost. Leave unset to keep unchanged.
budgeted_cost.human_parameter_description: How much you plan to spend on this campaign. Enter a number, or leave blank to keep the current amount.
budgeted_cost.title: Budgeted Cost

campaign_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the campaign to update.
campaign_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce ID of the campaign you want to update. You can copy this from the campaign's URL or use an ID returned by a previous search.
campaign_id.title: Campaign Id

custom_fields.description: Custom fields to update on the campaign. Use API field names (ending in __c). Leave empty if not updating custom fields.
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: A dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c'. For example: {'Priority__c': 'High', 'Region__c': 'North America'}.
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

description.description: Updated description. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
description.human_parameter_description: A short summary or notes about the campaign. Leave blank if you don't want to change it.
description.title: Description

end_date.description: Updated end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
end_date.human_parameter_description: The date the campaign should end, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave blank to keep the current end date.
end_date.title: End Date

expected_response.description: Updated expected response rate. Leave unset to keep unchanged.
expected_response.human_parameter_description: The response rate you expect from this campaign (as a percentage). Enter a number, or leave blank to keep the current value.
expected_response.title: Expected Response

expected_revenue.description: Updated expected revenue. Leave unset to keep unchanged.
expected_revenue.human_parameter_description: How much revenue you expect this campaign to generate. Enter a number, or leave blank to keep the current value.
expected_revenue.title: Expected Revenue

is_active.description: Updated active status. Leave as None to keep unchanged.
is_active.human_parameter_description: Choose whether the campaign should be active. Set to true for active, false for inactive, or leave empty to keep the current setting.
is_active.title: Is Active

name.description: Updated campaign name. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
name.human_parameter_description: The new name for the campaign. Leave blank if you don't want to change it.
name.title: Name

number_sent.description: Updated number sent. Leave unset to keep unchanged.
number_sent.human_parameter_description: The total number of messages, invites, or materials sent for this campaign. Enter a number, or leave blank to keep the current value.
number_sent.title: Number Sent

parent_id.description: Updated parent campaign ID. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
parent_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce ID of the parent campaign if this campaign is part of a hierarchy. Leave blank to keep the current parent.
parent_id.title: Parent Id

start_date.description: Updated start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
start_date.human_parameter_description: The date the campaign should start, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave blank to keep the current start date.
start_date.title: Start Date

status.description: Updated campaign status. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
status.human_parameter_description: The status you want to set for the campaign (e.g., Planned, In Progress). Leave blank to keep the existing status.
status.title: Status

type.description: Updated campaign type. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
type.human_parameter_description: The category that best describes this campaign (for example, Webinar or Email). Leave blank to keep the current type.
type.title: Type

name: update_campaign

UpdateCampaignResponse.description:
Response for successful campaign update.

HTTP 204 No Content - Salesforce returns empty body on successful update.
Error responses (4xx/5xx) are handled via raise_for_status().
UpdateCampaignResponse.title: UpdateCampaignResponse
